headline: Detecting AI Writing: Perplexity & Burstiness
summary: AI-generated text exhibits statistical fingerprints—low perplexity and uniform burstiness—that differ from human writing. Detection tools leverage these signals, but improving models constantly challenge static heuristics, requiring adaptive, human-in-the-loop systems.

slides.title: Spotting AI-Generated Text: The New Literacy
slides.subtitle: Learn the linguistic fingerprints that separate ChatGPT output from human writing.
slides.body: As AI writing floods the internet, distinguishing human from machine text becomes critical for trust and quality.
slides.deep_dive: Large language models like ChatGPT produce text with statistical regularities—predictable word choices, uniform sentence structures, and a lack of idiosyncratic errors—that differ from human writing's natural variability and contextual nuance.
slides.key_fact: AI text shows lower perplexity and burstiness than human writing.
slides.why_it_matters: Engineers building content platforms need reliable detection to maintain authenticity and prevent spam.

slides.title: The Explosion of AI Content Demands Detection
slides.body: Generative AI adoption has surged, flooding platforms with synthetic text that challenges moderation, SEO, and academic integrity.

slides.title: How Detection Works: Perplexity and Burstiness
slides.body: Detectors measure how surprised a model is by the text (perplexity) and variation in sentence complexity (burstiness).

steps.title: Calculate Perplexity
steps.desc: Low perplexity indicates predictable, AI-like word choices.

steps.title: Measure Burstiness
steps.desc: Human writing varies in sentence length and structure; AI tends to be uniform.

steps.title: Combine Signals
steps.desc: A weighted score flags text that is both too predictable and too uniform.

slides.title: Detection Tools vs. Evolving Models
slides.body: A race between detectors and increasingly human-like models.

slides.title: Integrating Detection Into Your Workflow
slides.body: Add a detection layer to content pipelines to flag synthetic text before publication.
slides.processing: Run perplexity/burstiness scoring via API or local model
slides.output: Flagged items for human review, automated filtering, or metadata tagging

slides.title: Detection Is a Moving Target, Not a Silver Bullet
slides.body: As models improve, detection must evolve from static heuristics to adaptive, context-aware systems.
takeaways: Build detection as a service, not a one-time filter.
Combine statistical signals with metadata and user behavior.
Plan for false positives: keep human-in-the-loop for high-stakes content.
